analysis: Examined base lines 907-1107 and head lines 1-460 of provider-swift/Tests/DarkbloomCLITests/SandboxSetupTests.swift. This is test-only code. Per the range map (complete), each change adds a `waitlist: .approved` argument to SandboxSetupFlow calls in tests, for example base/head 934, 967, 1026, 1053, 1072, 1085 and 1100. That points to a new waitlist parameter or check in SandboxSetupFlow in production source, which this batch does not include. The tests still assert the TB-013/T-061 controls: https-only installer URL (head 52-64); 200, https and shebang validation with a 1 MiB cap (head 66-114); an owner-only staged script, 0700 directory and 0600 file (head 133-142); confirmation before install (base 1062-1090); and the refusal of an ineligible Mac before any download (base 1012-1038). The change does not weaken any of these assertions. Integration should check the production SandboxSetupFlow waitlist parameter. Questions: whether the default value or the source of the waitlist state is the sandbox service, which is an untrusted input under TB-013; whether a waitlist response can skip the owner's confirmation or the installer validation; and whether it opens a new network request to a URL derived from the server. No regression is evident from these test units.
